per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The product shall enable people, including those who are not online‑savvy, to find and watch a film without getting frustrated; the UI shall be welcoming, modern, and simple so users do not get lost.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be easy for customers with novice skills on the Internet to purchase and watch streaming movies. Customers should be able to purchase and watch a pre-determined movie in under 3 minutes.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall be straightforward enough that most people can use it without training; it should be obvious where to go, how to buy, and how to play a movie.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be easy for customers with novice skills on the Internet to purchase and watch streaming movies. Customers should be able to purchase and watch a pre-determined movie in under 3 minutes.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Signing up shall be fast and limited to essential fields so users do not drop off mid‑signup; users should be able to create an account within at most four pages/screens.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Users should only have to navigate through a maximum of 4 pages to create an account with the website.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: A customer shall be able to pick a movie, pay, and start watching with minimal clicking and waiting; the end‑to‑end buy‑to‑first‑frame time shall be under three minutes (assuming reasonable user internet).
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be easy for customers with novice skills on the Internet to purchase and watch streaming movies. Customers should be able to purchase and watch a pre-determined movie in under 3 minutes.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The site shall feel snappy; routine interactive operations (page loads, add to cart) shall complete in roughly five seconds or less, since longer delays lead to user annoyance and abandonment.
Credit card transactions shall complete within approximately fifteen seconds; transactions longer than this increase abandonment and duplicate charges.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'When purchasing a streaming movie or pre-paid card via credit card the processing time should have a maximum response time of 15 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The platform shall continue to allow browsing and redemption of pre‑paid codes, and allow using existing balances, even if the external payment provider is unavailable (graceful degradation).
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall continue to operate if the payment gateway goes down.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Streaming playback shall be smooth; initial buffering introduced by the system should generally finish within about ten seconds (plus any user network lag), so users perceive playback as immediate.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: When streaming a movie the buffering time should take no longer than 10 seconds (plus any latency on the user's connection.)'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The service shall aim for an availability target of 99.5% over a year; availability below that level is unacceptable for platform credibility.
Access to full customer payment details shall be restricted to a few authorized Izogn admins; access shall be strictly controlled and audited.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All credit card information will be secured on the server and only accessible by authorized Izogn administrators. Information will be encrypted in the database.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Payment information stored in the database shall be encrypted so that, if accessed by an attacker, the data is not trivially usable.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All credit card information will be secured on the server and only accessible by authorized Izogn administrators. Information will be encrypted in the database.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall be upfront and transparent about data collection and usage; a clear privacy policy shall be provided before users enter personal data and must be easily discoverable.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall make its user aware of its information practices before collection data from them via a Privacy Policy accessible on all pages of the website.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: A link to the privacy policy shall be reachable from anywhere on the site, ideally present on every page.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall make its user aware of its information practices before collection data from them via a Privacy Policy accessible on all pages of the website.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Access to analytics dashboards shall be role‑based so that some users receive full reports and others only summaries; broad access to all analytics shall be prevented.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All credit card information will be secured on the server and only accessible by authorized Izogn administrators. Information will be encrypted in the database.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The UI shall minimize user friction: use big buttons, clear labels, minimal form fields, plain language, and provide a quick checkout option for returning customers.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be easy for customers with novice skills on the Internet to purchase and watch streaming movies. Customers should be able to purchase and watch a pre-determined movie in under 3 minutes.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall support localized text and multiple regional payment options (e.g., mobile money, pre‑paid cards) so users in different countries have suitable methods.
The platform shall support issuing, bulk‑generating, validating, and managing pre‑paid codes for partners, with clean operational management of redemptions.

The business shall remain able to operate even when partners or external providers experience hiccups; payments must remain secure and the platform must have resilience measures to keep revenue flowing.
